name: Sen'jin Village
summary: Sen'jin Village shelters the Darkspear on Durotar's southern shore. Vol'jin led them there after Zalazane seized the Echo Isles, and gave the refuge his fallen father's name. Across the shallows, their lost home waits.

sections.title: A Refugee Shore
sections.body:
The Darkspear survivors have made their refuge on Durotar's shore. After Zalazane betrayed the tribe and seized the Echo Isles, Chieftain Vol'jin led them across the strait to the mainland. They raised crude huts beneath coastal cliffs, with the water and their lost home in view.

The village bears the name of Sen'jin, Vol'jin's father. Murlocs captured and sacrificed him during the Third War. Though the Darkspear are closely allied with Thrall's Horde, exile remains their burden. The lost isles lie just across the shallows.

sections.title: Eyes on the Isles
sections.body:
Preparation and defense shape life in Sen'jin Village. Quilboar raids, aggressive sea beasts, and Zalazane's hexes from across the sea threaten the villagers. Herbal remedies and potent alchemical spirits help sustain them.

Vol'jin coordinates the tribe's wider defense from the Horde capital. Meanwhile, local shamans, hunters, and scouts gather recruits arriving from the Valley of Trials. The Darkspear seek resources, guard Durotar's southern flank, and plan Zalazane's downfall.

faq.q: Why did the Darkspear build Sen'jin Village here?
aliases: why did trolls leave echo isles
faq.answer: Zalazane seized the Darkspear home on the Echo Isles, so they crossed the strait to Durotar's coast. Vol'jin founded Sen'jin Village as a refuge and gathering place across the water from their lost land.

Sen'jin was a respected witch doctor and chieftain of the Darkspear, and Vol'jin's father. During the Third War, he foresaw Thrall's arrival, but murlocs captured and sacrificed him to their Sea Witch before Thrall could save him.

faq.q: Why are there so many herbalists and alchemists here?
faq.answer: Local witch doctors and medicine men use Durotar's coastal plants and scorpok venoms to make charms, antidotes, and ritual brews. These remedies tend the wounded and ward against hexes from the Echo Isles.

faq.q: Can you reach the Echo Isles from Sen'jin Village?
aliases: how to get to echo isles
faq.answer: The Echo Isles lie across the eastern water from Sen'jin Village. You can swim or wade across the shallow channel to confront Zalazane's voodoo cultists, recover stolen artifacts, or gather resources for the village defenders.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll emerging from the Valley of Trials, you find refuge among your displaced people. The village holds memories of your lost chieftain and the sting of Zalazane's betrayal.
As a herbalist, you can learn natural medicine in Sen'jin Village. Coastal Peacebloom, Silverleaf, and Earthroot help local witch doctors treat venom and curses.
